positions.meaning: The past: what led to the situation
The present: the situation as it stands
The future: where things are heading

celtic_cross.name: Celtic Cross (Waite)
celtic_cross.source: Waite 1911 order: 1 covers, 2 crosses, 3 crowns, 4 beneath, 5 behind, 6 before; the staff 7-10 from the bottom up. No significator. Dignities run along the lines: 1-2, 3-1-4, 5-1-6 and 7-8-9-10.

positions.name: covers
positions.meaning: What covers you: the general influence at work in the matter now

positions.name: crosses
positions.meaning: What crosses you: the obstacle or opposing force in the matter, for good or ill

positions.name: crowns
positions.meaning: What crowns you: the aim or ideal, the best that can be reached, not yet made real

positions.name: beneath
positions.meaning: What is beneath you: the foundation of the matter, what is already yours

positions.name: behind
positions.meaning: What is behind you: the influence that is passing or has just passed away

positions.name: before
positions.meaning: What is before you: the influence coming into action in the near future

positions.name: yourself
positions.meaning: Yourself: your own position and attitude in the matter

positions.name: your house
positions.meaning: Your house: the people and surroundings around you, and their influence

positions.name: hopes and fears
positions.meaning: Your hopes and fears in the matter

positions.name: what will come
positions.meaning: What will come: the outcome the other cards lead to

positions.name: Sun
positions.meaning: Energy; where it comes from

positions.name: Mercury
positions.meaning: Messages, advice

positions.name: Venus
positions.meaning: What is comfortable

positions.name: Earth
positions.meaning: Where you stand

positions.name: Mars
positions.meaning: What is active

positions.name: Jupiter
positions.meaning: What is given

positions.name: Saturn
positions.meaning: What is restricted

positions.name: Uranus
positions.meaning: What is unique

positions.name: Neptune
positions.meaning: Where your imagination can lead you

positions.name: Pluto
positions.meaning: What must change

single.name: One card
single.source: A single card drawn for the question. With no neighbours it is neither well nor ill dignified.

positions.name: the card
positions.meaning: The card for the question: the heart of the matter
